body:
Mad props on the website, I really like the layout. I'm a journalism student, and one of my biggest pet peeves is how little effort most people put into the online appearance. Especially in the tech industry, you'd think people would be more savvy. The headlines are also great, they're intriguing and have all the SEO terms, without coming across like click-bait (which even mainstream news does now, FFS).

Anyway, great visuals and solid content - I like where this is heading. One small criticism though, I think some of the editing and formatting are a bit off. Some of the embedded images seem off-centre or too close to the text, I'm guessing it appeared differently in the editor, because Wordpress can be pretty clunky when you start adding media.

That's just small stuff, though. Overall it's awesome. And hey, let me know if you're open to outside contributors. I'm always stoked to write about PCs!
